instruction: I need to highlight all the italicized text in this document for better visibility. Can you apply yellow highlighting to all italic words while keeping the italic formatting?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying yellow highlight to all italic text. Evaluator checks if all 21 italic runs have highlight color applied. Verified document has 21 italic text runs that need highlighting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: applies yellow highlighting to all italic text while preserving italic formatting.
Metric function properly checks for WD_COLOR_INDEX.YELLOW (line 29 of docs.py), ensuring only yellow highlights are accepted, not any color.
Complete coverage: iterates through all paragraphs and runs, counts all italic text, and verifies each has yellow highlight color.

Robust edge case handling: handles empty documents (returns 0.0 when italic_count==0), whitespace-only runs (checks run.text.strip()), missing highlight colors (verifies run.font.highlight_color exists), and document read errors (try/except returns 0.0).
Postconfig is appropriate: activates LibreOffice Writer window and saves document with Ctrl+S to ensure file state is persisted for verification.
Binary scoring (1.0 for all italic text highlighted yellow, 0.0 otherwise) correctly matches the 'all or nothing' nature of the requirement.
